preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the polygon is between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.
The needed angle is between 1 and 180 degrees inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly three space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: Each of the three integers is a valid vertex number between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: min(abs((360 / n * (v1 - v2) % 360) - a), abs((360 / n * (v3 - v2) % 360) - a)) == min(abs((360 / n * (x - y) % 360) - a) for x in range(1, n+1) for y in range(1, n+1) for z in range(1, n+1) if len(set([x, y, z])) == 3)
postconditions.description: The angle formed by the vertices v1, v2, v3 is as close as possible to the needed angle a.
